title: Particle burst
description: A seeded burst from one point that punctuates a beat, a cut or a click: white-hot sparks cooling to the accent, tumbling confetti strips, glass shards, ripple rings, or hand-drawn burst lines. The point draws in for a beat, then ignites with a flare. An optional word pops at the point first. Transparent, to drop over video.

shape.description: What bursts: sparks (white-hot streaks with a fall of embers), confetti (paper strips that flip as they fall), shards (splinters turning in the light), rings (ripples with a dust of dots), lines (short strokes shot evenly round, the drawn sparkle accent), dots.

count.description: How many particles (lines: one stroke per 6, 6 to 24).

origin.description: Where it bursts, {x, y} from 0 to 1.

colors.description: Particle colours as #rrggbb (empty: the accent and secondary; confetti adds the ink).

rings.description: Two ripple rings spreading from the point with any shape.

gravity.description: How fast particles fall, px/s² at 1080.

label.description: A short word in a pill that pops at the point before the burst (empty: none).
